note: Reconstructed from the architecture proposal recorded in docs/architecture/CONTROLLED_TECHNICAL_LANGUAGE_HARNESS.md. Not extracted from ASD-STE100 and not equivalent to it.

rules.statement: A procedural sentence states one instruction.
A procedural sentence does not exceed the declared word budget.
A descriptive sentence does not exceed the declared word budget.
An instruction uses the active voice and the imperative.
A word carries one approved meaning within one document.
A Technical Name or Technical Verb is used only if the project termbase admits it.
A warning or caution precedes the step it applies to.

implementation_notes: STE-P-02 and STE-P-03 word budgets are implemented deterministically in scripts/lint_deterministic.py. STE-P-04 and STE-P-07 are heuristic and remain unimplemented; they may only be admitted through scripts/check_heuristic_calibration.py, which forbids a heuristic from concluding a run. STE-P-01, STE-P-05 and STE-P-06 need a bound termbase and document class that the request contract supplies at runtime.
